verdict: IMPROVED knockout-context transformer (transformer_ko2.py): v1's set-of-tokens transformer + four upgrades (CLS cross-attention pooling, a distillation/InfoNCE objective distilling the response-neighbour distribution into the embedding, val-tuned similarity-weighted top-K transfer, and a val-tuned hybrid with raw DepMap cosine). 3-split held-out K562 (tide-removed specific recall@50): v1 baseline 0.476 -> v2 0.483 (oracle 0.607, tide 0.249). v2 - v1 = +0.007+/-0.022 -- NO stable improvement: the upgrades do not beat v1 by a reliable margin, so v1's mean-pool + cosine-MSE + mean-transfer was already near the best this representation supports; the remaining gap to the oracle is representation/data-limited, not a readout/objective problem. Gene-identity control PASSES (wrong-KO 0.111 < v2). Single cell type, steady-state mRNA, magnitude target, CPU; deterministic per split.
